// Acceptance for task (c): the signature, a wider Host store, and a child that depends on a slice of the result.
import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import { createStore, type ListenerError, type ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";
import { createPricingContextModule } from "./c-pricing-context.js";
import type { PricingContextDeps, PricingContextProduct } from "./c-pricing-context.types.js";

const signature: (deps: PricingContextDeps, context: ModuleContext) => Promise<PricingContextProduct> = createPricingContextModule;
type HostSettings = { readonly currency: string; readonly region: string; readonly theme: string };
declare const context: ModuleContext;
declare const reportError: (report: ListenerError) => undefined;
const host = createStore<HostSettings>({ currency: "EUR", region: "de", theme: "light" }, { name: "settings", resources: context.resources, reportError });
export async function wire(): Promise<ReadonlyStore<{ readonly vatRate: number }>> {
  const product = await signature({ settings: host.readonly(), errors: { report: reportError } }, context);
  return product.capabilities["acme/pricing/context"];
}
